يستقذرون (form X)
# يَسْتَقْذِرُونَ (yastaqḏirūna) /jas.taq.ði.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
# يُسْتَقْذَرُونَ (yustaqḏarūna) /jus.taq.ða.ruː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْذَرَ (istaqḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
